__inputs.name: DS_POSTGRES
__inputs.label: PostgreSQL
__inputs.description: PostgreSQL datasource of the platform (database web-ui, schema afzs_fulda)

description: Automatic passenger counting (Strabag APC, Rhönenergie): boardings/alightings, occupancy, stops, trip analysis (load profile of a single trip), doors and data quality from the tables of the apc-importer (schema afzs_fulda, read directly from the platform PostgreSQL). Source: tenant-eichenzell grafana/dashboards/component-apc.json.

panels.title: Events
panels.description: Door-closing events (one XML = one event) in the time range for the selected vehicles/lines.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM ${schema}.events WHERE $__timeFilter(event_ts) AND vehicle_id IN (${vehicle:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(line_ref, '') IN (${line:sqlstring})

panels.title: Boardings
panels.description: Sum of all valid boardings (all doors, all classes).

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(sum(boarding_total), 0) FROM ${schema}.events WHERE $__timeFilter(event_ts) AND vehicle_id IN (${vehicle:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(line_ref, '') IN (${line:sqlstring})

panels.title: Alightings
panels.description: Sum of all valid alightings.

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(sum(alighting_total), 0) FROM ${schema}.events WHERE $__timeFilter(event_ts) AND vehicle_id IN (${vehicle:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(line_ref, '') IN (${line:sqlstring})

panels.title: Vehicles
panels.description: Vehicles that sent at least one event in the time range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT vehicle_id) FROM ${schema}.events WHERE $__timeFilter(event_ts) AND vehicle_id IN (${vehicle:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(line_ref, '') IN (${line:sqlstring})

panels.title: Invalid events
panels.description: Events with negative or non-numeric count values (`valid = false`). Should be 0.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM ${schema}.events WHERE $__timeFilter(event_ts) AND vehicle_id IN (${vehicle:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(line_ref, '') IN (${line:sqlstring}) AND NOT valid

panels.title: Last event
panels.description: Seconds since the last event of the selected vehicles (independent of time range and line).

targets.rawSql: SELECT min(age_seconds) FROM ${schema}.v_vehicle_status WHERE vehicle_id IN (${vehicle:sqlstring})

panels.title: Boardings / alightings
panels.description: Sum per time interval; the interval follows the time range (minimum 5 minutes). Alightings are plotted downwards for readability.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroup(event_ts, $__interval) AS time,
       sum(boarding_total)   AS "Boardings",
       -sum(alighting_total) AS "Alightings"
FROM ${schema}.events
WHERE $__timeFilter(event_ts) AND vehicle_id IN (${vehicle:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(line_ref, '') IN (${line:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Occupancy per vehicle
panels.description: Cumulative occupancy (boardings minus alightings) per vehicle and operating day. Negative values mean more alightings counted than ever boarded – counting incomplete or sensor drifting.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT event_ts AS time, vehicle_id AS metric, occupancy AS value
FROM ${schema}.v_occupancy
WHERE $__timeFilter(event_ts) AND vehicle_id IN (${vehicle:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(line_ref, '') IN (${line:sqlstring})
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Passengers per day by class
panels.description: Boardings per operating day, split by ObjectClass (Adult, Child, Bike, …).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('day', e.event_ts) AS time, c.object_class AS metric, sum(c.boarding) AS value
FROM ${schema}.events e JOIN ${schema}.counts c ON c.event_id = e.id
WHERE $__timeFilter(e.event_ts) AND e.vehicle_id IN (${vehicle:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(e.line_ref, '') IN (${line:sqlstring}) AND c.boarding IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Events per vehicle
panels.description: How many door closings each vehicle reports per time interval; the interval follows the time range (minimum 5 minutes). A vehicle in service that stops delivering events has stopped sending (SFTP, device, network).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroup(event_ts, $__interval) AS time, vehicle_id AS metric, count(*) AS value
FROM ${schema}.events
WHERE $__timeFilter(event_ts) AND vehicle_id IN (${vehicle:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(line_ref, '') IN (${line:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Top stops by boardings
panels.description: The 15 stops with the most boardings in the time range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT coalesce(stop_name, stop_ref, '?') AS "Stop", sum(boarding_total) AS "Boardings", sum(alighting_total) AS "Alightings"
FROM ${schema}.events
WHERE $__timeFilter(event_ts) AND vehicle_id IN (${vehicle:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(line_ref, '') IN (${line:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Stop map
panels.description: Stops derived from the GNSS positions of the events, size and color by boardings. Positions are the mean of all events at the stop.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT coalesce(stop_name, stop_ref, '?') AS "Stop",
       avg(latitude)  AS latitude,
       avg(longitude) AS longitude,
       sum(boarding_total)  AS "Boardings",
       sum(alighting_total) AS "Alightings",
       count(*)             AS "Events"
FROM ${schema}.events
WHERE $__timeFilter(event_ts) AND vehicle_id IN (${vehicle:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(line_ref, '') IN (${line:sqlstring}) AND latitude IS NOT NULL AND longitude IS NOT NULL AND latitude <> 0 AND longitude <> 0
GROUP BY 1

panels.title: Per line
panels.description: Key figures per line in the time range. Max. occupancy = highest cumulative occupancy of a vehicle on this line.

targets.rawSql:
WITH occ AS (
    SELECT coalesce(line_ref, '?') AS line, max(occupancy) AS max_occ
    FROM ${schema}.v_occupancy WHERE $__timeFilter(event_ts) GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT coalesce(e.line_ref, '?') AS "Line",
       count(DISTINCT e.vehicle_id) AS "Vehicles",
       count(*) AS "Events",
       sum(e.boarding_total) AS "Boardings",
       sum(e.alighting_total) AS "Alightings",
       max(occ.max_occ) AS "Max. occupancy",
       sum(CASE WHEN e.valid THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS "Invalid"
FROM ${schema}.events e
LEFT JOIN occ ON occ.line = coalesce(e.line_ref, '?')
WHERE $__timeFilter(e.event_ts) AND e.vehicle_id IN (${vehicle:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(e.line_ref, '') IN (${line:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 4 DESC

panels.title: Per stop
panels.description: Boardings and alightings as well as mean dwell time (door opening to door closing) per stop.

targets.rawSql:
WITH dwell AS (
    SELECT coalesce(e2.stop_name, e2.stop_ref, '?') AS stop, avg(c.dwell_seconds) AS avg_dwell
    FROM ${schema}.counts c JOIN ${schema}.events e2 ON e2.id = c.event_id
    WHERE $__timeFilter(e2.event_ts) AND c.dwell_seconds IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT coalesce(e.stop_name, e.stop_ref, '?') AS "Stop",
       count(DISTINCT e.line_ref) AS "Lines",
       count(*) AS "Events",
       sum(e.boarding_total) AS "Boardings",
       sum(e.alighting_total) AS "Alightings",
       max(dwell.avg_dwell) AS "Avg. dwell time"
FROM ${schema}.events e
LEFT JOIN dwell ON dwell.stop = coalesce(e.stop_name, e.stop_ref, '?')
WHERE $__timeFilter(e.event_ts) AND e.vehicle_id IN (${vehicle:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(e.line_ref, '') IN (${line:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 4 DESC

panels.title: Selected trip
panels.description: The trip selected in the variable "Trip": vehicle, service day, line, destination, first arrival, last departure and number of stop visits.

targets.rawSql:
WITH e AS (
    SELECT ev.*,
           CASE WHEN coalesce(ev.service_journey_ref, '') <> '' THEN ev.service_journey_ref
                ELSE coalesce(ev.line_ref, '') || '>' || coalesce(ev.destination, '') END AS journey_key,
           CASE WHEN ev.valid THEN ev.boarding_total - ev.alighting_total ELSE 0 END AS net
    FROM ${schema}.events ev
    JOIN (SELECT vehicle_id, service_date FROM ${schema}.events WHERE id = ${trip}) k
      ON k.vehicle_id = ev.vehicle_id AND k.service_date = ev.service_date
), seg AS (
    SELECT e.*,
           LAG(journey_key) OVER (ORDER BY event_ts, sequential_number, id) AS prev_key,
           LAG(event_ts)    OVER (ORDER BY event_ts, sequential_number, id) AS prev_ts,
           SUM(net)         OVER (ORDER BY event_ts, sequential_number, id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) - net AS occ_before
    FROM e
), num AS (
    SELECT seg.*,
           SUM(CASE WHEN prev_ts IS NULL OR prev_key <> journey_key OR prev_ts < event_ts - INTERVAL '${trip_gap}' MINUTE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
               OVER (ORDER BY event_ts, sequential_number, id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS trip_no
    FROM seg
), trip AS (
    SELECT * FROM (SELECT num.*, MAX(CASE WHEN id = ${trip} THEN trip_no END) OVER () AS sel_trip FROM num) n WHERE trip_no = sel_trip
), sv AS (
    SELECT t.*,
           SUM(CASE WHEN prev_stop IS NULL OR prev_stop <> coalesce(stop_ref, stop_name, '') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
               OVER (ORDER BY event_ts, sequential_number, id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS stop_no,
           FIRST_VALUE(occ_before) OVER (ORDER BY event_ts, sequential_number, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS occ_start
    FROM (SELECT trip.*, LAG(coalesce(stop_ref, stop_name, '')) OVER (ORDER BY event_ts, sequential_number, id) AS prev_stop FROM trip) t
), per_stop AS (
    SELECT sv.stop_no,
           max(coalesce(sv.stop_name, sv.stop_ref, '?')) AS stop,
           min(coalesce(sv.event_start, sv.event_ts)) AS arrival,
           max(coalesce(sv.actual_departure_time, sv.event_end, sv.event_ts)) AS departure,
           count(*) AS events,
           sum(sv.boarding_total) AS boardings,
           sum(sv.alighting_total) AS alightings,
           max(sv.occ_start) AS occ_start,
           max(sv.occ_start) + SUM(sum(sv.net)) OVER (ORDER BY sv.stop_no ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS occupancy,
           sum(CASE WHEN sv.valid THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS invalid,
           avg(sv.latitude) AS latitude,
           avg(sv.longitude) AS longitude,
           COUNT(*) OVER () AS n_stops,
           max(sv.vehicle_id) AS vehicle_id,
           max(CAST(sv.service_date AS varchar)) AS service_date,
           max(coalesce(sv.line_ref, '?')) AS line_ref,
           max(coalesce(sv.destination, '?')) AS destination
    FROM sv
    GROUP BY sv.stop_no
)
SELECT max(vehicle_id) AS "Vehicle",
       max(service_date) AS "Day",
       max(line_ref) AS "Line",
       max(destination) AS "Destination",
       min(arrival) AS "Start",
       max(departure) AS "End",
       count(*) AS "Stops"
FROM per_stop

panels.title: Passengers of the trip
panels.description: Boardings/alightings of the selected trip and its occupancy. Occupancy is the cumulative occupancy since the start of the service day (as in "Occupancy per vehicle"), so it includes passengers already on board when the trip started and drifts with counting errors; negative values are shown in red. Max. occupancy = highest occupancy after departure from a stop.

    SELECT sv.stop_no,
           max(coalesce(sv.stop_name, sv.stop_ref, '?')) AS stop,
           min(coalesce(sv.event_start, sv.event_ts)) AS arrival,
           max(coalesce(sv.actual_departure_time, sv.event_end, sv.event_ts)) AS departure,
           count(*) AS events,
           sum(sv.boarding_total) AS boardings,
           sum(sv.alighting_total) AS alightings,
           max(sv.occ_start) AS occ_start,
           max(sv.occ_start) + SUM(sum(sv.net)) OVER (ORDER BY sv.stop_no ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS occupancy,

panels.title: Route of the trip
panels.description: Stops of the selected trip in route order (GNSS position of the events), connected as a route; marker size and color by occupancy after departure, label = stop number. Stops without a usable GNSS position are omitted.

panels.title: Stops of the trip
panels.description: One row per stop visit of the selected trip: arrival = first door opening, departure = last actual departure (or door closing), dwell = longest door-open duration at the stop, occupancy after departure (cumulative since start of service day).

targets.rawSql:
WITH e AS (
    SELECT ev.*,
           CASE WHEN coalesce(ev.service_journey_ref, '') <> '' THEN ev.service_journey_ref
                ELSE coalesce(ev.line_ref, '') || '>' || coalesce(ev.destination, '') END AS journey_key,

           SUM(net)         OVER (ORDER BY event_ts, sequential_number, id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) - net AS occ_before
    FROM e
), num AS (
    SELECT seg.*,
           SUM(CASE WHEN prev_ts IS NULL OR prev_key <> journey_key OR prev_ts < event_ts - INTERVAL '${trip_gap}' MINUTE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

    FROM seg

    FROM (SELECT trip.*, LAG(coalesce(stop_ref, stop_name, '')) OVER (ORDER BY event_ts, sequential_number, id) AS prev_stop FROM trip) t
), per_stop AS (
    SELECT sv.stop_no,
           max(coalesce(sv.stop_name, sv.stop_ref, '?')) AS stop,
           min(coalesce(sv.event_start, sv.event_ts)) AS arrival,
           max(coalesce(sv.actual_departure_time, sv.event_end, sv.event_ts)) AS departure,
           count(*) AS events,
           sum(sv.boarding_total) AS boardings,
           sum(sv.alighting_total) AS alightings,
           max(sv.occ_start) AS occ_start,
           max(sv.occ_start) + SUM(sum(sv.net)) OVER (ORDER BY sv.stop_no ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS occupancy,
           sum(CASE WHEN sv.valid THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS invalid,
           avg(sv.latitude) AS latitude,

           COUNT(*) OVER () AS n_stops,
           max(sv.vehicle_id) AS vehicle_id,

    FROM sv

, dw AS (
    SELECT e2.stop_no, max(c.dwell_seconds) AS dwell
    FROM ${schema}.counts c JOIN sv e2 ON e2.id = c.event_id
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT p.stop_no AS "No.", p.stop AS "Stop", p.arrival AS "Arrival", p.departure AS "Departure", dw.dwell AS "Dwell",
       p.events AS "Events", p.boardings AS "Boardings", p.alightings AS "Alightings", p.occupancy AS "Occupancy", p.invalid AS "Invalid"
FROM per_stop p LEFT JOIN dw ON dw.stop_no = p.stop_no
ORDER BY p.stop_no

), seg AS (
    SELECT e.*,
           LAG(journey_key) OVER (ORDER BY event_ts, sequential_number, id) AS prev_key,
           LAG(event_ts)    OVER (ORDER BY event_ts, sequential_number, id) AS prev_ts,
           SUM(net)         OVER (ORDER BY event_ts, sequential_number, id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) - net AS occ_before
    FROM e
), num AS (
    SELECT seg.*,
           SUM(CASE WHEN prev_ts IS NULL OR prev_key <> journey_key OR prev_ts < event_ts - INTERVAL '${trip_gap}' MINUTE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
               OVER (ORDER BY event_ts, sequential_number, id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS trip_no
    FROM seg
), trip AS (
    SELECT * FROM (SELECT num.*, MAX(CASE WHEN id = ${trip} THEN trip_no END) OVER () AS sel_trip FROM num) n WHERE trip_no = sel_trip
), sv AS (
    SELECT t.*,
           SUM(CASE WHEN prev_stop IS NULL OR prev_stop <> coalesce(stop_ref, stop_name, '') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
               OVER (ORDER BY event_ts, sequential_number, id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS stop_no,
           FIRST_VALUE(occ_before) OVER (ORDER BY event_ts, sequential_number, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS occ_start
    FROM (SELECT trip.*, LAG(coalesce(stop_ref, stop_name, '')) OVER (ORDER BY event_ts, sequential_number, id) AS prev_stop FROM trip) t
), per_stop AS (
    SELECT sv.stop_no,
           max(coalesce(sv.stop_name, sv.stop_ref, '?')) AS stop,
           min(coalesce(sv.event_start, sv.event_ts)) AS arrival,
           max(coalesce(sv.actual_departure_time, sv.event_end, sv.event_ts)) AS departure,
           count(*) AS events,
           sum(sv.boarding_total) AS boardings,
           sum(sv.alighting_total) AS alightings,
           max(sv.occ_start) AS occ_start,
           max(sv.occ_start) + SUM(sum(sv.net)) OVER (ORDER BY sv.stop_no ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS occupancy,
           sum(CASE WHEN sv.valid THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS invalid,
           avg(sv.latitude) AS latitude,
           avg(sv.longitude) AS longitude,
           COUNT(*) OVER () AS n_stops,
           max(sv.vehicle_id) AS vehicle_id,
           max(CAST(sv.service_date AS varchar)) AS service_date,
           max(coalesce(sv.line_ref, '?')) AS line_ref,
           max(coalesce(sv.destination, '?')) AS destination
    FROM sv
    GROUP BY sv.stop_no
)
SELECT c.object_class AS "Class", sum(c.boarding) AS "Boardings"
FROM ${schema}.counts c
WHERE c.event_id IN (SELECT id FROM trip) AND c.boarding IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Trips in time range
panels.description: All trips detected in the time range for the selected vehicles/lines (see variable "Trip gap"). Max. occupancy from the cumulative day occupancy (valid events only), net = boardings − alightings within the trip. Click a row to open the dashboard with that trip selected (new tab).

targets.rawSql:
WITH e AS (
    SELECT id, vehicle_id, service_date, event_ts, sequential_number, line_ref, destination, stop_ref, stop_name, boarding_total, alighting_total, valid,
           CASE WHEN coalesce(service_journey_ref, '') <> '' THEN service_journey_ref
                ELSE coalesce(line_ref, '') || '>' || coalesce(destination, '') END AS journey_key
    FROM ${schema}.events
    WHERE $__timeFilter(event_ts) AND vehicle_id IN (${vehicle:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(line_ref, '') IN (${line:sqlstring})
), seg AS (
    SELECT e.*,
           LAG(journey_key) OVER (PARTITION BY vehicle_id, service_date ORDER BY event_ts, sequential_number, id) AS prev_key,
           LAG(event_ts)    OVER (PARTITION BY vehicle_id, service_date ORDER BY event_ts, sequential_number, id) AS prev_ts,
           LAG(coalesce(stop_ref, stop_name, '')) OVER (PARTITION BY vehicle_id, service_date ORDER BY event_ts, sequential_number, id) AS prev_stop
    FROM e
), num AS (
    SELECT seg.*,
           SUM(CASE WHEN prev_ts IS NULL OR prev_key <> journey_key OR prev_ts < event_ts - INTERVAL '${trip_gap}' MINUTE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
               OVER (PARTITION BY vehicle_id, service_date ORDER BY event_ts, sequential_number, id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS trip_no,
           CASE WHEN prev_stop IS NULL OR prev_stop <> coalesce(stop_ref, stop_name, '') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_stop
    FROM seg
), ends AS (
    SELECT num.*,
           FIRST_VALUE(coalesce(stop_name, stop_ref, '?')) OVER (PARTITION BY vehicle_id, service_date, trip_no ORDER BY event_ts, sequential_number, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS first_stop,
           LAST_VALUE(coalesce(stop_name, stop_ref, '?'))  OVER (PARTITION BY vehicle_id, service_date, trip_no ORDER BY event_ts, sequential_number, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS last_stop
    FROM num
)
SELECT min(x.event_ts) AS "Start",
       max(x.event_ts) AS "End",
       x.vehicle_id AS "Vehicle",
       max(coalesce(x.line_ref, '?')) AS "Line",
       max(coalesce(x.destination, '?')) AS "Destination",
       max(x.first_stop) AS "First stop",
       max(x.last_stop) AS "Last stop",
       sum(x.new_stop) AS "Stops",
       count(*) AS "Events",
       sum(x.boarding_total) AS "Boardings",
       sum(x.alighting_total) AS "Alightings",
       sum(x.boarding_total - x.alighting_total) AS "Net",
       max(o.occupancy) AS "Max. occupancy",
       sum(CASE WHEN x.valid THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS "Invalid",
       min(x.id) AS "Trip ID"
FROM ends x LEFT JOIN ${schema}.v_occupancy o ON o.event_id = x.id
GROUP BY x.vehicle_id, x.service_date, x.trip_no
ORDER BY 1 DESC

panels.title: Boardings per door
panels.description: Share of boardings per door. Door 1 = front.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 'Door ' || coalesce(c.door_id, '?') AS "Door", sum(c.boarding) AS "Boardings"
FROM ${schema}.events e JOIN ${schema}.counts c ON c.event_id = e.id
WHERE $__timeFilter(e.event_ts) AND e.vehicle_id IN (${vehicle:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(e.line_ref, '') IN (${line:sqlstring}) AND c.boarding IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Alightings per door
panels.description: Share of alightings per door.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 'Door ' || coalesce(c.door_id, '?') AS "Door", sum(c.alighting) AS "Alightings"
FROM ${schema}.events e JOIN ${schema}.counts c ON c.event_id = e.id
WHERE $__timeFilter(e.event_ts) AND e.vehicle_id IN (${vehicle:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(e.line_ref, '') IN (${line:sqlstring}) AND c.alighting IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Door open duration
panels.description: Mean time from door opening to door closing per time interval and door (from CountInfo); the interval follows the time range (minimum 5 minutes).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroup(e.event_ts, $__interval) AS time, 'Door ' || coalesce(c.door_id, '?') AS metric, avg(c.dwell_seconds) AS value
FROM ${schema}.events e JOIN ${schema}.counts c ON c.event_id = e.id
WHERE $__timeFilter(e.event_ts) AND e.vehicle_id IN (${vehicle:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(e.line_ref, '') IN (${line:sqlstring}) AND c.dwell_seconds IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Issues
panels.description: All entries from the view `v_issues` in the time range (errors + warnings).

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM ${schema}.v_issues WHERE $__timeFilter(event_ts) AND vehicle_id IN (${vehicle:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(line_ref, '') IN (${line:sqlstring})

panels.title: Errors
panels.description: Issues with severity = error (negative/invalid count values).

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM ${schema}.v_issues WHERE $__timeFilter(event_ts) AND vehicle_id IN (${vehicle:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(line_ref, '') IN (${line:sqlstring}) AND severity = 'error'

panels.title: Sequence gaps
panels.description: Missing events according to sequence number – XMLs were lost on the way from the bus to the server.

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(sum(missing_count), 0) FROM ${schema}.v_sequence_gaps WHERE $__timeFilter(event_ts) AND vehicle_id IN (${vehicle:sqlstring}) AND missing_count > 0

panels.title: Regular count quality
panels.description: Share of individual counts with CountQuality = Regular.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CAST(sum(CASE WHEN c.count_quality = 'Regular' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS double precision) / nullif(count(*), 0)
FROM ${schema}.events e JOIN ${schema}.counts c ON c.event_id = e.id
WHERE $__timeFilter(e.event_ts) AND e.vehicle_id IN (${vehicle:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(e.line_ref, '') IN (${line:sqlstring})

panels.title: Import errors
panels.description: XML files the importer could not read (stored in the rejected folder).

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM ${schema}.import_files WHERE status = 'error' AND $__timeFilter(imported_at)

panels.title: Last import
panels.description: Seconds since the last successful import (view v_import_status).

targets.rawSql: SELECT age_seconds FROM ${schema}.v_import_status

panels.title: Issues per day by type
panels.description: Distribution of check-rule hits over time.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('day', event_ts) AS time, issue_type AS metric, count(*) AS value
FROM ${schema}.v_issues
WHERE $__timeFilter(event_ts) AND vehicle_id IN (${vehicle:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(line_ref, '') IN (${line:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Vehicle status
panels.description: Latest state per vehicle (independent of the time range) plus events and issues in the selected time range.

targets.rawSql:
WITH ev AS (
    SELECT vehicle_id, count(*) AS n FROM ${schema}.events WHERE $__timeFilter(event_ts) GROUP BY 1
), iss AS (
    SELECT vehicle_id, count(*) AS n FROM ${schema}.v_issues WHERE $__timeFilter(event_ts) GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT s.vehicle_id AS "Vehicle",
       s.last_event_ts AS "Last event",
       s.age_seconds AS "Age",
       s.last_line_ref AS "Line",
       s.last_stop_name AS "Stop",
       s.device_state AS "Device",
       s.firmware_version AS "Firmware",
       coalesce(ev.n, 0) AS "Events",
       coalesce(iss.n, 0) AS "Issues"
FROM ${schema}.v_vehicle_status s
LEFT JOIN ev ON ev.vehicle_id = s.vehicle_id
LEFT JOIN iss ON iss.vehicle_id = s.vehicle_id
WHERE s.vehicle_id IN (${vehicle:sqlstring})
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Issues
panels.description: One row per event and check rule from the view `v_issues`. severity `error` = faulty data, `warn` = check plausibility.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT event_ts AS "Time", severity AS "Severity", issue_type AS "Type", vehicle_id AS "Vehicle", sequential_number AS "Seq",
       line_ref AS "Line", stop_name AS "Stop", detail AS "Details"
FROM ${schema}.v_issues
WHERE $__timeFilter(event_ts) AND vehicle_id IN (${vehicle:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(line_ref, '') IN (${line:sqlstring})
ORDER BY event_ts DESC
LIMIT 500

panels.title: Imported files
panels.description: The last 50 imports (file name, timestamp, status).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT imported_at AS "Imported", file_name AS "File", status AS "Status", event_count AS "Events", file_size AS "Size", error AS "Error"
FROM ${schema}.import_files
ORDER BY imported_at DESC
LIMIT 50

list.query: SELECT DISTINCT vehicle_id FROM ${schema}.events ORDER BY 1

list.query: SELECT DISTINCT coalesce(line_ref, '') FROM ${schema}.events ORDER BY 1

list.name: trip_gap
list.label: Trip gap (min)
list.description: Trip detection: a new trip starts when line, destination (or ServiceJourneyRef, if delivered) change or when no event was recorded for longer than this many minutes.

list.name: trip
list.label: Trip
list.description: Trips detected in the time range for the selected vehicles/lines (newest first): start (local time) · vehicle · line → destination · first – last stop. The value is the ID of the trip's first event.
list.definition:
WITH e AS (
    SELECT id, vehicle_id, service_date, event_ts, sequential_number, line_ref, destination, stop_ref, stop_name, boarding_total, alighting_total,
           CASE WHEN coalesce(service_journey_ref, '') <> '' THEN service_journey_ref
                ELSE coalesce(line_ref, '') || '>' || coalesce(destination, '') END AS journey_key
    FROM ${schema}.events
    WHERE $__timeFilter(event_ts) AND vehicle_id IN (${vehicle:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(line_ref, '') IN (${line:sqlstring})
), seg AS (
    SELECT e.*,
           LAG(journey_key) OVER (PARTITION BY vehicle_id, service_date ORDER BY event_ts, sequential_number, id) AS prev_key,
           LAG(event_ts)    OVER (PARTITION BY vehicle_id, service_date ORDER BY event_ts, sequential_number, id) AS prev_ts
    FROM e
), num AS (
    SELECT seg.*,
           SUM(CASE WHEN prev_ts IS NULL OR prev_key <> journey_key OR prev_ts < event_ts - INTERVAL '${trip_gap}' MINUTE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
               OVER (PARTITION BY vehicle_id, service_date ORDER BY event_ts, sequential_number, id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS trip_no
    FROM seg
), ends AS (
    SELECT vehicle_id, service_date, trip_no,
           FIRST_VALUE(coalesce(stop_name, stop_ref, '?')) OVER (PARTITION BY vehicle_id, service_date, trip_no ORDER BY event_ts, sequential_number, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS first_stop,
           LAST_VALUE(coalesce(stop_name, stop_ref, '?'))  OVER (PARTITION BY vehicle_id, service_date, trip_no ORDER BY event_ts, sequential_number, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS last_stop
    FROM num
), trips AS (
    SELECT vehicle_id, service_date, trip_no, min(id) AS trip_id, min(event_ts) AS start_ts,
           max(coalesce(line_ref, '?')) AS line_ref, max(coalesce(destination, '?')) AS destination
    FROM num GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
)
SELECT CAST(t.trip_id AS varchar) || '|' || substr(CAST(t.start_ts AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin' AS varchar), 1, 16)
       || ' · ' || t.vehicle_id || ' · L' || t.line_ref || ' → ' || t.destination || ' · ' || x.first_stop || ' – ' || x.last_stop AS trip
FROM trips t
JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT vehicle_id, service_date, trip_no, first_stop, last_stop FROM ends) x
  ON x.vehicle_id = t.vehicle_id AND x.service_date = t.service_date AND x.trip_no = t.trip_no
ORDER BY t.start_ts DESC
list.query:
WITH e AS (
    SELECT id, vehicle_id, service_date, event_ts, sequential_number, line_ref, destination, stop_ref, stop_name, boarding_total, alighting_total,
           CASE WHEN coalesce(service_journey_ref, '') <> '' THEN service_journey_ref
                ELSE coalesce(line_ref, '') || '>' || coalesce(destination, '') END AS journey_key
    FROM ${schema}.events
    WHERE $__timeFilter(event_ts) AND vehicle_id IN (${vehicle:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(line_ref, '') IN (${line:sqlstring})
), seg AS (
    SELECT e.*,
           LAG(journey_key) OVER (PARTITION BY vehicle_id, service_date ORDER BY event_ts, sequential_number, id) AS prev_key,
           LAG(event_ts)    OVER (PARTITION BY vehicle_id, service_date ORDER BY event_ts, sequential_number, id) AS prev_ts
    FROM e
), num AS (
    SELECT seg.*,
           SUM(CASE WHEN prev_ts IS NULL OR prev_key <> journey_key OR prev_ts < event_ts - INTERVAL '${trip_gap}' MINUTE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
               OVER (PARTITION BY vehicle_id, service_date ORDER BY event_ts, sequential_number, id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS trip_no
    FROM seg
), ends AS (
    SELECT vehicle_id, service_date, trip_no,
           FIRST_VALUE(coalesce(stop_name, stop_ref, '?')) OVER (PARTITION BY vehicle_id, service_date, trip_no ORDER BY event_ts, sequential_number, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS first_stop,
           LAST_VALUE(coalesce(stop_name, stop_ref, '?'))  OVER (PARTITION BY vehicle_id, service_date, trip_no ORDER BY event_ts, sequential_number, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS last_stop
    FROM num
), trips AS (
    SELECT vehicle_id, service_date, trip_no, min(id) AS trip_id, min(event_ts) AS start_ts,
           max(coalesce(line_ref, '?')) AS line_ref, max(coalesce(destination, '?')) AS destination
    FROM num GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
)
SELECT CAST(t.trip_id AS varchar) || '|' || substr(CAST(t.start_ts AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin' AS varchar), 1, 16)
       || ' · ' || t.vehicle_id || ' · L' || t.line_ref || ' → ' || t.destination || ' · ' || x.first_stop || ' – ' || x.last_stop AS trip
FROM trips t
JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT vehicle_id, service_date, trip_no, first_stop, last_stop FROM ends) x
  ON x.vehicle_id = t.vehicle_id AND x.service_date = t.service_date AND x.trip_no = t.trip_no
ORDER BY t.start_ts DESC
